QuestInfo.name: Gathering Training Equipment
QuestInfo.0: So Gong has something to ask of you. Go speak with So Gong.
QuestInfo.1: You are told that the training equipment do not last because so many are always training. Go get some training equipment so that the training can run smoothly.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta gathered the training equipment for So Gong so the trainees could focus on their training.

0.0: Hey! Shouldn't you be training? The other trainees are wearing down the equipment with their awesome power. What are you doing?! Help me right now!

yes.0: It is good to see the trainees working so hard, but there simply isn't enough training equipment to go around. Go get #r 20 #t4009000##k and #r 10 #t4009001##r#k items so no one will be without something to beat on.

no.0: If you aren't helping, you need to be training!

1.0: Did you get enough Straw Target Dummies?

yes.0: This will do, for a day or so...

default.0: Some of the trainees have worn out their gear. Bring #r20 #t4009000##k and #r10 #t4009001##r#k items.
